statuses.implemented-equivalent: Expose a Rust API with substantially equivalent capability and observable behavior.
statuses.implemented-adapted: Preserve the capability/behavior but intentionally use a Rust-native API or ownership/type model.
statuses.unsupported-webgl-specific: Exclude because the API exists specifically for WebGL and has no meaningful WebGPU role.
statuses.unsupported-js-specific: Exclude only when the API expresses JavaScript runtime semantics with no useful Rust engine capability.
statuses.deferred: Known useful capability intentionally outside this MVP; must have an explicit frozen rationale.

member_policy: All generated public/protected-like members inherit the containing exported type's default_status unless listed in member_overrides.
